text: My daughter was turning 20 and wanted a mermaid themed cake saying ‘she’s H20’ (I think it’s something off tik tok!) I contacted Dreamy Cake Bakery as I wanted something special and judging from her photos I knew I was in the right place!! I literally sent a WhatsApp, she got back to me right away, I gave her some ideas of what I wanted, but said it’s entirely up to her how she created it. Well just wow, when we collected it was so stunning and pretty and my daughter ABSOLUTELY LOVED IT! The cake itself tasted amazing, we’ve been grazing off it for a week! It cut beautifully and stayed together, it wasn’t stodgy or too dense and it wasn’t too sickly. Honestly the best cake ever in looks and taste and was well worth the money. Highly recommend! We will be using again for sure x
